question: A patient is undergoing radiation treatment involving two beams, Beam 1 and Beam 2. Beam 1 delivers a dose of 0.3 units of medicine per minute to the benign area of the pancreas and 0.2 units of medicine per minute to the benign area of the skin. Beam 2 delivers 0.2 units of medicine per minute to the benign area of the pancreas and 0.1 units of medicine per minute to the benign area of the skin.  In addition, beam 1 delivers 0.6 units of medicine per minute to the tumor and beam 2 delivers 0.4 units of medicine per minute to the tumor. At most 4 units of medicine should be received by the skin and at least 3 units of medicine should be delivered to the tumor.  How many minutes of each beam should be used to minimize the total radiation received by the pancreas?

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "beams": ["beam1", "beam2"],
    # medicine delivered per minute to the benign pancreas by each beam
    "pancreas": {"beam1": 0.3, "beam2": 0.2},
    # medicine delivered per minute to the benign skin by each beam
    "skin": {"beam1": 0.2, "beam2": 0.1},
    # medicine delivered per minute to the tumor by each beam
    "tumor": {"beam1": 0.6, "beam2": 0.4},
    # at most this many units may be received by the skin
    "skin_limit": 4.0,
    # at least this many units must be delivered to the tumor
    "tumor_min": 3.0,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # ---- Sets -------------------------------------------------------------
    model.BEAMS = pyo.Set(initialize=d["beams"])

    # ---- Variables --------------------------------------------------------
    # minutes of each beam (nonnegative, continuous)
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.BEAMS, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, None))

    # ---- Objective: minimize radiation to the benign pancreas -------------
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["pancreas"][b] * m.x[b] for b in m.BEAMS)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # ---- Constraint: at most skin_limit units received by the skin --------
    def skin_rule(m):
        return sum(d["skin"][b] * m.x[b] for b in m.BEAMS) <= d["skin_limit"]

    model.skin_limit_con = pyo.Constraint(rule=skin_rule)

    # ---- Constraint: at least tumor_min units delivered to the tumor ------
    def tumor_rule(m):
        return sum(d["tumor"][b] * m.x[b] for b in m.BEAMS) >= d["tumor_min"]

    model.tumor_min_con = pyo.Constraint(rule=tumor_rule)

    return model
